title: Pressurised connecting tunnel, straight bay
summary: A 6 m straight surface tunnel bay on two ground trestles: a bellows-ribbed pressure sleeve on the 2.4 m port axis with hab-ports at both ends and handrails down both flanks.

title: Inflatable dome habitat
summary: A 7.2 m soft-goods dome habitat inflated over a rigid base ring, held by a meridian strap net and eight ground anchors, with a dust skirt, crown hatch and two side hab-ports.

title: Inflatable dome habitat with regolith shielding
summary: The dome habitat buried to the shoulder under a graded regolith berm and two courses of filled bags, the shielding fit used once a base moves from a short sortie to a permanent crew rotation.

title: Rigid cylinder crew habitat on legs
summary: An 8 m metal-shell crew habitat carried clear of the regolith on four splayed legs with wide footpads, with three viewports, a roof radiator strip, an access ladder and axial hab-ports at both ends.

title: Pressurised connecting tunnel, quarter turn
summary: A quarter-turn tunnel bay that swings the run through ninety degrees between two hab-ports 3 m from the corner, carried on two ground trestles.

title: Rigid cylinder logistics module on legs
summary: The same legged pressure shell fitted out for stores: no viewports, external cargo racks and tie-down rails down both flanks and a dorsal equipment hatch.

title: Pressurised connecting tunnel, tee junction
summary: A three-way tunnel junction on a central ground column: a lens-shaped pressure vessel with a crown surface hatch, an access ladder and three hab-ports 3 m out on the fore, aft and starboard axes.

title: Regolith shielded habitat
summary: An 8 m pressure shell buried under a 4.7 m graded regolith arch held by three retaining ribs and two horseshoe end walls, with only the end domes and their hab-ports left in the open.

title: Cupola observation turret
summary: A 7.6 m glazed watch turret on a column and plinth: a twelve-panel window drum under a conical dust roof, an external ground stair to a platform, a mast light and a tunnel spur back to the site grid.

title: Pressurised greenhouse module
summary: A 9.2 m barrel-vault growing module on a plinth: a ribbed transparent shell over three tiers of hydroponic trays and LED light bars either side of a central service spine, with hab-ports on both end walls.

title: Airlock with dust-lock vestibule
summary: A two-chamber surface airlock on a raised plinth: a dust-lock vestibule with a hinged outer hatch and boarding ramp on named nodes, a five-nozzle dust removal rail, two rear-entry suit ports on the flank and a tunnel spur to the site grid.

title: Regolith bucket drum excavator
summary: A 5.5 m four-wheel regolith excavator: a counter-rotating bucket drum with three rows of scoops on a hydraulic lift boom, a tipping spoil body, a drive cabinet and a suited operator station, all on wire-mesh wheels with steering uprights.

title: Pressurised workshop and vehicle bay
summary: A 9.4 m wide arched vehicle bay on a graded slab: a ribbed hard shell with a 5.2 m roll-up door on a named node, exterior workbench, gas bottle rack and two floodlights, and a hab-port spur on the port flank.

title: Regolith hopper and screening deck
summary: A 4.4 m feed hopper on four splayed legs over an inclined vibrating screen deck: nine screen bars, two shaker motors on spring mounts, a fines discharge chute into a spoil pile, an oversize chute, an access ladder and a walkway.

title: Oxygen extraction plant skid
summary: A 4.4 m process skid on bearing pads: two hydrogen reduction reactor vessels with support skirts, a cyclone separator, a helical condenser coil, gas pipework, a control cabinet and a rack of product gas bottles.

title: Medical and crew care module
summary: A 4.6 m diameter vertical pressure vessel on a six-leg ring with a dust skirt, two viewports, a rack of external gas bottles, an eight-panel wall radiator and a casualty hoist davit, with hab-ports on the aft and starboard faces.

title: Water processing skid
summary: A 4 m water recovery skid on bearing pads: two horizontal holding vessels, a pump set with a drive motor, three filter columns on a header, a control cabinet, run pipework and a railed maintenance walkway with a ladder.

title: Fixed solar array row
summary: A 9.9 m row of six fixed photovoltaic panels on braced ground posts with bearing pads, a spine beam, a cable trunk and a combiner box, set at a steep tilt for a low sun.

title: Regolith sintering print gantry
summary: A 5 m portal gantry on 8 m ground rails that sinters regolith into structure: a rolling portal with a cross bridge, a sintering head on a named slide, a part printed regolith wall of ten courses on its bed, a feed hopper and a power cabinet.

title: Vertical solar tower
summary: An 8.4 m guyed solar mast carrying four vertical photovoltaic blades on a ballasted berm foundation, the layout used near a pole where the sun stays close to the horizon, with a beacon and a ground junction box.

title: Thermal radiator bank
summary: A 4.6 m ground-mounted heat rejection bank: six vertical radiator fins with header pipes strung between an upper and lower manifold on a braced frame, with a pump module and connecting runs.

title: Tracking solar array row
summary: The same six-panel row rebuilt on taller posts with a horizontal torque tube, so each panel is a named node that rotates to follow the sun across the sky.

title: Battery storage container
summary: A 3.4 m energy storage container on a bolted skid with bearing pads: five bays of cells behind a ribbed shell, a bank of cooling fins, a switchgear door with a state of charge panel, two heavy cable couplings and a roof handrail.

title: Nuclear power unit with shielding berm
summary: A 6.5 m surface fission power unit standing inside a graded regolith shielding berm: a ribbed reactor drum, a conical shadow shield, six heat pipe stalks up to a conical radiator umbrella with twelve spines, an instrument mast, a power cabinet and four keep-out markers.

title: Crew lander with ascent cabin
summary: A 6.6 m four-leg crew lander: an octagonal descent stage on crushable footpads with four tanks and an engine, a pressurised ascent cabin with three viewports, an EVA hatch onto a railed porch, a boarding ladder, a docking cone, antennas and four attitude control pods.

title: Cargo lander with unloading ramp
summary: A 7 m four-leg cargo lander on crushable footpads: an octagonal deck over four descent tanks and an engine, a cargo pallet with a stores container and tie-down rails, a hinged unloading ramp on a named node, four attitude control pods and a ladder.

title: Sintered landing pad
summary: A 14 m circular landing pad graded and sintered into the regolith: a raised apron with a sixteen-segment plate pattern, three concentric target rings and a centre bullseye, ringed by eight lit edge markers.

title: Blast berm segment
summary: A 6 m modular regolith blast berm for a pad perimeter: a graded 2 m bank with a compacted toe, five marker posts and a retaining rail on the pad side.

title: Landing pad blast deflector wall
summary: A 6 m wide curved blast deflector for a landing pad rim: a battered concave wall on six raked buttresses that spread to 8.9 m, with ballast blocks and bearing pads, topped by five hazard markers.

title: Cryogenic propellant tank farm
summary: A 7.6 m propellant storage set on a graded apron: two 3 m spherical cryogenic tanks on skirt stands with radial braces and relief valve heads, a vaporiser, a valve gallery, run pipework and a railed access platform with a ladder.

title: Approach light beacon
summary: A 4.9 m guyed approach beacon for a landing site: a tripod-braced mast with ballast blocks and bearing pads, a strobe head under a glass dome, three hazard bands and a tilted photovoltaic panel feeding a battery box.

title: Cryogenic transfer arm tower
summary: A 6.9 m braced transfer tower with a counterweighted articulated arm: an inner boom on a slew bearing, a folding outer boom, a coupling head and a draped vacuum jacketed hose, each joint a named node, with a ground control cabinet.

title: Open unpressurised crew rover
summary: A 2.9 m four-wheel open crew rover for suited drivers: a tubular chassis on four open wire-mesh wheels with steering uprights, double wishbones and fenders, two mesh seats, a T-handle controller, a steerable dish, a whip antenna, a stereo camera mast and a rear equipment pallet.

title: Open crew rover, science fit
summary: The open crew rover rigged for traverse science: a tail-mounted core drill, an instrument pallet on the rear deck, a stowed magnetometer boom on a named node and a sample container in place of the stores box.

title: Small robotic survey rover
summary: A 1.6 m six-wheel robotic survey rover on a rocker bogie suspension with named rocker and bogie arms, a deck-mounted photovoltaic panel, a stereo camera mast, a small sampling arm and a low gain antenna.

title: Pressurised long range rover
summary: A 6.3 m six-wheel pressurised traverse rover: a lofted cabin over a bogie chassis on six wire-mesh wheels, a steered front pair, wraparound glazing, roof photovoltaics and radiators, a steerable dish, a camera mast and two rear entry suit ports with a boarding ladder.

title: Six-wheel cargo hauler with flatbed
summary: A 7 m six-wheel surface hauler: an open forward control station with a roll frame over a bogie chassis on wire-mesh wheels, a ribbed flatbed with stake pockets and tie-down rails, a stores container and a hinged tail ramp on a named node.

title: Six-wheel cargo hauler with cryogenic tank
summary: The same six-wheel hauler chassis carrying a 4.8 m cryogenic vessel in three saddle cradles, with a pump skid, a transfer boom and a coupling head instead of the flatbed.

title: Surface EVA suit
summary: A 1.95 m surface extravehicular suit standing on the regolith: a hard upper torso on a hip bearing, jointed arms and legs on named nodes, a bubble helmet with a gold sun visor, a life support backpack with a valve panel and comms whip, and dust-stained overboots.

title: Four-wheel crane rover
summary: A 4.6 m four-wheel lifting rover: a slewing turntable and counterweight on a wheeled chassis with all-wheel steering, four extending outriggers with screw jacks and bearing pads, an operator cab and a two-stage telescopic boom with a hook block, every joint a named node.

title: EVA tool cart
summary: A 2 m two-wheel hand barrow for suited crew: a tubular frame on wire-mesh wheels with a folding ground stand, an inclined load deck, a lidded stores box, an open sample tray and a rack of four stowed hand tools behind a padded push bar.

title: Hand pulled equipment sled
summary: A 2.9 m hand-pulled sled for short traverses: two curved skid runners bridged by a load deck, two strapped stores boxes, a soft sample bag and a rigid tow bar on a named node.

title: Regolith ground tile
summary: A 12 m square regolith ground tile: rolling mare relief with four impact craters between 1.2 and 4.4 m across, feathered to a common rim height on all four edges so tiles butt together in any orientation.

title: Crater rim segment tile
summary: A 12 m square tile dominated by the rim and inner wall of a 10.8 m crater: a raised crest, a bowl falling away inside it and blocky ejecta scattered along the crest.

title: Boulder field tile
summary: A 12 m square tile strewn with eleven weathered boulders between 0.6 and 2.1 m across, sitting part buried in rolling regolith around a shallow crater.

title: Rille edge tile
summary: A 12 m square tile carrying the edge of a collapsed lava channel: a 6.8 m wide rille cut 2.3 m below the plain with slumped banks either side, feathered across its width only so the channel runs straight through into the next tile.

title: Rover track ruts tile
summary: A 12 m square tile of trafficked regolith: a pair of 1.5 m gauge rover ruts with chevron grouser prints pressed along them, spoil ridges either side and a line of boot prints alongside.

title: Graded dust berm
summary: A 10 m graded regolith berm pushed up to shield a work area from rover dust: a tapered bank with a compacted apron, a spoil line along its toe and a marker post at each end.

title: Survey marker array
summary: A 2.4 m survey station: three graduated range poles with black and white targets on ballasted bases, a corner cube retroreflector on a levelling tripod and a photometric gnomon with a calibration strip on a base plate.

title: Communications relay mast
summary: A 9.5 m guyed lattice relay mast on four ballasted footings: eight braced bays, three guy wires to anchor blocks, a 2.1 m steerable dish on a yoke as a named node, three whip antennas, a photovoltaic panel and a ground equipment box.

title: Lunar Colony Overview
summary: A working surface base: two tunnel junctions link a crew habitat, an inflatable dome, an observation turret, a greenhouse, a medical module, a regolith shielded habitat, an airlock and a vehicle workshop, every mate made through the hab-port interface 2.4 m above the...

title: Landing Pad Operations
summary: A cargo lander standing on the sintered pad on its four crushable footpads, ringed by two blast deflector walls and two regolith berm segments mated to the pad rim markers. A crew lander waits on the apron, a cryogenic tank farm, a transfer arm and a battery container sit...

title: Resource and Power Yard
summary: The extraction and utilities end of the base: an excavator feeding a hopper and screening deck, an oxygen extraction plant, a water processing skid and a sintering print gantry laying a regolith wall, backed by a fixed and a tracking photovoltaic row, a solar tower, a...

title: Connector Cases
summary: Independent test assemblies covering both connector families. Every habitat, tunnel, junction, elbow, greenhouse, workshop, turret and airlock in the pack is mated through a hab-port, and both landers, both blast deflectors and both berm types are mated to landing pad...
